annotations.title: Close out my day or month

description: One read-only call for what you still need to do before closing a day or a month (1日の締め / 月末の締め). Returns a priority list: missing clock-out or break-end (退勤・休憩戻), a break shorter than the Labor Standards Act (over 6h worked needs 45 min, over 8h needs 60 min — a 3-minute lunch punch is not enough), man-hours missing or not matching time worked (工数), the monthly overtime estimate (法定時間外の目安), and alerts. Use this INSTEAD OF chaining get_today_status, check_attendance_issues, get_manhours, summarize_working_hours, and get_alerts. scope "day" (default) is one day, default today in Japan (Asia/Tokyo). scope "month" is that month through today, or the whole month if it has ended. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Months are YYYY-MM (01-12). When ok is true and items is empty, tell the user nothing else is required (headline says 対応は不要). Follow items in priority order. If action says 修正申請, do NOT call punch — the API cannot edit past stamps. This tool never punches or saves. Writes still need punch / save_manhours / delete_manhours after the user confirms.

date.description: scope=day only. YYYY-MM-DD in Japan time. Defaults to today. Future dates are rejected. Do not pass this with scope=month.

month.description: scope=month only. YYYY-MM (month 01-12) in Japan time. Defaults to the current month. Future months are rejected. Do not pass this with scope=day.

scope.description: day (default): one day. month: the whole month up to today, or through month-end if that month is already over.

thresholdHours.description: Monthly statutory-overtime estimate that counts as a problem, in hours. Default 45 (the standard 36-agreement month). The figure is still only an estimate.
